verdict.rationale: The pack has no documented capability for versioning scenarios, reviewing changes between versions, or rolling back to a prior version. The bare title "scenario history" does not show whether it means version history or run history. "Clone a scenario" is a manual copy workaround, and audit logs are an adjacent control, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
